conventions: B = 1 unless the case sets B. Pair cases without 'state' start from K = smallest rung >= sigma_old for both policies, with no earlier exhaustion.
labels given as a list apply to both A0-pad policies (tight-refit and structural-step); a dict gives them per policy. Canonical label order W0 W1 W2 W3 W4 W5 W6 W6x shrink.
adapter_lines given as an integer applies to every design (A0-tight, A0-pad, PX, MR, A1).
strict: the strict reading (W6x counted as W6) equals the primary reading unless a 'strict' block is given.
path_kinds keys: added leaf = new path; removed leaf = old path; matched leaf = its path, or 'old->new' when the path strings differ.
statement lists every policy field with a non-empty change list (class null when no W class applies).
A policy given as a list of paths names fields by their path and uses the same path in both versions.
regen true implies artefacts [circuit, keys, verifier]; false implies [].

Pair case: old = base, new = base with ops applied in order. History case: versions v1..vn; v1 = base with its ops, each later version = the previous version with its ops; a list policy holds for every version.
Ops: add (append leaf), remove (by path), set (top-level key of a leaf), setc (constraint key; value null deletes it), repath (change the path string; later ops use the new path).
A key absent from an expected block is not checked; every present key is checked exactly (kinds compared as sets, labels as sets).
'e' (bool) in an expected transition checks Algorithm 1's e; 'h' on a case sets MR's depth (default 32).

cases.rule: Algorithm 1 l.16-17 take precedence over l.18: one A0-pad regeneration, K refitted
Algorithm 1 l.18: an e-only A0-pad regeneration leaves K unchanged and is not an exhaustion (the next exhaustion is W2)
Algorithm 1 l.3-13: only statement fields can set e; carrier retype, pattern, format and code-list loss regenerate nothing
Algorithm 1 l.20 boundary: sigma' = 2^h (h = 4) -> MR does not regenerate
Algorithm 1 l.20: sigma' = 17 > 2^4 -> MR regenerates (with A0-pad exhaustion, l.16-17)
Algorithm 1 l.20 with the default h = 32: sigma' = 14 + 65536*65537 > 2^32 -> MR; structural-step beyond the ladder: K := sigma' (l.17)
Algorithm 1 l.20 boundary with h = 32: sigma' = 14 + 2*2147483641 = 2^32 -> MR does not regenerate
Ladder L ends at 4096 (Algorithm 1 input L, macros \KLadder): structural-step reaches the rung 4096, then sigma' = 4097 is beyond the ladder: K := sigma' (l.17 'or sigma' if no rung covers it')
Initial K beyond the ladder (sigma(v1) = 5014 > 4096): K := sigma(v1) (as l.17); an unchanged release regenerates nothing
Algorithm 1 l.3 (revised): a policy field with no path in either version is skipped, not W6
Algorithm 1 l.8-9 (renamed) and, independently, l.10-11: codes(p) = {A,B} not a subset of {A} -> e
Algorithm 1 l.8-9: renamed -> W6; l.12: f is in W6, so the code-list extension does not make it W6x; no e
Algorithm 1 l.4: the policy path issued resolves to the leaf issued[] of v'; l.8-9 the path strings differ -> W6; l.10-11 bounds [] -> [1] differ -> e (delta 0)
Algorithm 1 l.3: ghost is undefined in v1 and v2, so it is skipped there; in v2 -> v3 it is added (l.5-6, W6, no e)
